REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, September 05, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.

6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-k, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of August 15, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Receive and file the 2017 Strategic Planning Session Final Report
ACTION: That the City Council receive and file the 2017 Strategic Planning Session Final Report.
Item #7d
e.
Approval of Final Map for Tract Map No. 73720 (25024 Narbonne Avenue and 2154 250th Street)
ACTION: That the City Council approve Final Map for Tract Map No. 73720 as recommended by the City's Engineering consultant HR Green.
Item #7e
f.
Approve an Amendment to Cooperation Agreement with the Community Development Commission of the County of Los Angeles
ACTION: To receive and file the Amendment to the Cooperation Agreement with the Community Development Commission of the County of Los Angeles (CDC).
Item #7f
g.
Approve an Amendment to Professional Services Agreement with JFS Care to provide operating services for Lifeline Personal Response System (Lifeline) Program
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to approve an amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with JFS Care to provide operating services for Lifeline Personal Response System Program.
Item #7g
h.
Approve an Amendment to Professional Services Agreement with Michael Baker International Inc. to provide management and administrative services for Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to approve an amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Michael Baker International, Inc.to provide management and administrative services for the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program.
Item #7h
i.
Notice of Completion for Water Main Replacement on Reed Street and Forrester Drive
ACTION: That the City Council approve the following:
1.
Accept the work performed by Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc.; and
2.
Authorize the Public Works Department to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $5,890.55 to Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the NOC with the County Recorder's Office.
Item #7i
j.
Award an Agreement for Street Sweeping Services to R.F. Dickson Company, Inc.
ACTION: That the City Council approve the following:
1)
Award an agreement to R.F. Dickson Company, Inc. in the amount of $7,515.11 for Street Sweeping Services; and
2)
Approve a total contract budget of $107,266.62 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions; and
3)
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement.
Item #7j
k.
Consider award of a Professional for Services Agreement to CivilSource, Inc. for design services for Water Main Replacement on Pacific Coast Highway between Narbonne Avenue and Eshelman Avenue
ACTION: That the City Council approve the following:
1)
Award a professional services agreement to CivilSource, Inc., in the amount of $60,934 to perform design services to replace the Pacific Coast Highway (PCH) water main; and
2)
Approve a total contact budget of $67,027.40 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions); and
3)
Authorize the City Manager to sign the agreement.
Item #7k
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
APPEAL OF PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION APPROVAL TO ALLOW TWO 2-HOUR PARKING SPACES AT 2266 LOMITA BOULEVARD (APPELLANT REQUESTS A 30-MINUTE PARKING RESTRICTION TO TWO SUBJECT PARKING SPACES)
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: That the Traffic Technical Advisory Committee (TTAC) recommends that the City Council deny the appeal requesting a 30-minute parking restriction and uphold the Public Safety Traffic Commission's (PSTC) approval for a 2-hour Parking restriction between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., excluding holidays for two spaces in front of 2266 Lomita Boulevard.
Item #8
9.
ADOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to an Adjourned Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, September 12, 2017 at 5:30 p.m. at City Hall Upstairs Conference Room located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Dated this 1st Day of September 2017
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
